label: Bilibili
terms_note: Developer registration with identity verification (个人 or 企业), app approval, per-scope permission (users must re-authorize when scopes are added); OAuth 2.0 (access_token + refresh); archive submission capability granted per app; Bilibili community rules (投稿规范) apply; deauthorization messages pushed to the app.

capabilities: post(video archive — after 稿件分发 approval)

auth: 1. Complete 身份信息 (personal or enterprise) → review → create an application → apply for scopes (e.g. USER_INFO,
2. OAuth 2.0 authorization code → `access_token` / `refresh_token`; when a NEW scope is approved existing users must
3. Deauthorization / account-deletion events are pushed to the app (消息推送-用户解除授权).

endpoints.call: POST /arcopen/fn/archive/add-by-utoken` {title, tid, tag, desc, copyright, no_reprint}

reference.limits: - Scope-gated per app; 投稿规范 (community rules, 原创 / 转载 declaration); per-app quotas in the console. - 哔哩哔哩开放平台开发者服务协议 + 隐私政策 (links on the home page).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: client_id of your Bilibili open-platform app (openhome.bilibili.com); also the x-bili-accesskeyid of every signed call.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app secret (app_secret); signs every call (HMAC-SHA256) and is sent only to the refresh endpoint.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: The user's refresh_token from the OAuth2 code exchange (https://api.bilibili.com/x/account-oauth2/v1/token, scopes USER_INFO, ARC_BASE, ARC_DATA). Single-use: each refresh returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

me.note: 获取用户公开信息 (scope USER_INFO): name, face, openid of the authorising user.

delete.note: 视频稿件删除 (scope ARC_BASE): irreversibly deletes one of the user's video submissions by resource_id (BV id).

analytics_post.note: 获取单个稿件数据 (scope ARC_DATA): view, danmaku, reply, favorite, coin, share, like, title and ptime of one video submission (BV id) the user authored or co-authored.

not_offered.publish_text: Bilibili's open platform publishes videos (服务端视频稿件投递: upload → chunk merge → submit) and 专栏 articles; 文章提交 (https://open.bilibili.com/doc/4/b14b77b6-8889-8c8b-2e83-17c5a4c550fb) requires title, category, template_id, a summary and 200–40000 characters of content, more than a text post carries.
not_offered.publish_image: Images are only uploaded as article/cover material (专栏稿件图片上传, multipart file); there is no image-post API (https://open.bilibili.com/doc/4/0eaa4d3e-c4c0-f874-6f3c-e083aa939a1b).
not_offered.read_comments: The open-platform document tree (https://member.bilibili.com/arcopen/user/open-doc/view?id=4) has no comment-reading API; 获取单个稿件数据 returns only the reply count.
not_offered.reply_comment: No comment-reply API is documented in the open-platform tree (https://member.bilibili.com/arcopen/user/open-doc/view?id=4).
not_offered.read_mentions: No mentions/@ API is documented in the open-platform tree (https://member.bilibili.com/arcopen/user/open-doc/view?id=4).

adapter.terms: Every arcopen call carries the v2.0 signature (https://open.bilibili.com/doc/4/8673959e-f7bb-56e6-6e68-d225f971b81b): x-bili-* headers (accesskeyid = client_id, content-md5 = MD5 of the exact body, HMAC-SHA256, nonce, version 2.0, timestamp) sorted and signed with app_secret into Authorization, plus the OAuth access-token header; responses are {code: 0, message, data}. Access tokens are refreshed daily from the single-use refresh token (the token response's expires_in is an absolute time, not a duration).

evidence: host member.bilibili.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
